instruction.text: Read and listen along to these two texts about knitting.

atoms.text: Text 1: Daniel loves to knit. His grandma showed him how to knit when he was very young, and now they often sit and knit together. His grandma taught him to make all sorts of things: hats, mittens and even socks. Daniel likes to make socks the most.
atoms.sound: ssml: Text one. <break time='600ms'/> Daniel loves to knit. His grandma showed him how to knit when he was very young, and now they often sit and knit together. His grandma taught him to make all sorts of things: hats, mittens and even socks. Daniel likes to make socks the most.

atoms.a: Whose point of view does this text discuss?
How does Daniel feel about knitting?
b: Daniel gets frustrated with knitting easily.

atoms.a: Why is Daniel good at knitting?
b: ++because he often does it with his grandma

atoms.text: Text 2: Suri gets frustrated knitting. She struggles to hold the needles in her hands and her yarn is always falling off. At least her cat really likes playing with the string. She thought she would like this new hobby, but she finds she does not have the patience for it!
atoms.sound: ssml: Text two. <break time='600ms'/> Suri gets frustrated knitting. She struggles to hold the needles in her hands and her yarn is always falling off. At least her cat really likes playing with the string. She thought she would like this new hobby, but she finds she does not have the patience for it!

atoms.a: Whose point of view does this text discuss?
How does Suri feel about knitting?
b: She enjoys knitting socks a lot.

atoms.a: Why does Suri not like knitting?
b: because her cat likes the yarn

atoms.b: ability to not get annoyed by something frustrating
